value.summary: The change renames the crate import from `openhuman_core::openhuman` to `openhuman_core`, which may affect the path to items like `oh::tools::traits` used on the next line. This is a mechanical rename that does not introduce any security problem — no untrusted input, no new network or subprocess calls, no deserialization, no secrets, no permission changes. It is safe to merge as long as `openhuman_core::openhuman` was a publicly re-exported module that the new flat path also resolves correctly, which is a build-coherence check the compiler will enforce.
